verdict.rationale: The xAI API exposes many core capabilities that also appear in the Grok UI. These include text generation and conversations, tool use, image generation and editing, text-, image- and reference-to-video, multi-agent research, and speech-to-text, and a published OpenAPI spec exists. However, nothing in the evidence shows API access to many UI-only features: built-in connectors (Gmail, Drive, Teams, Salesforce), Grok Bot, conversation sharing, workspace and team management, SSO, and billing. missing for 10: API equivalents for connectors, Grok Bot, workspace/team admin, conversation sharing/sync, and billing, plus an explicit parity statement or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Generate text, have conversations, use tools, and build AI-powered applications.
The API supports batch generation of multiple images, and control over aspect ratio, resolution, and quality.
The API supports configurable duration, aspect ratio, and resolution
Realtime Multi-agent Research enables Grok to orchestrate multiple AI agents that work together in real time to perform deep, multi-step research tasks.
